regime_context: Hong Kong thematic ranks show a narrow, defensively-led tape: only 5 of 17 names clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates & Exchange, and Tech Hardware & Semis), and banks lead with at best 0.63 durability and weak/mixed breadth (0.615). Momentum rank is a focus lens only; the trend gate is the one validated leg and it is genuinely helping here, so eligible = staying-power candidates, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks → Energy rotation margin closes: the current margin is 0.184 with absorption at 0.47 and rotation.directional=false. A confirmed handoff would need Energy to overtake Banks in score while BOTH remain gate-eligible and Energy's durability_bar stays ≥0.7 at the time of the cross; if the margin instead widens back above 0.3, the Banks-leadership read stands.
